spec: os/2-identity/README.md section 10 + section 13.1 A10; os/6-transport/README.md section 14 (D26 #3)
description: A10 transport_id assignment for bridge identities. 0x02 meshtastic: transport_key = the board's X25519 public key, transport_sig = 64 zero bytes on 2.7.x boards (cannot sign) => ONE-SIDED (node_sig only; never attested-111). 0x03 reticulum: transport_key = SHA-256(pubkey64), pubkey64 = X25519(32) || Ed25519(32) as the helper reports it (ready.pubkey); transport_sig = Ed25519 by the identity's signing key (pubkey64[32..64]) over '111/attest-transport/v1' || node_pubkey => both legs. Wire and node_sig are the unchanged 202 B section 10 format. 'node_leg' is id111's built-in verify_node_leg token (ok | err:node-sig:<VerifyError>). 'plug' is the node111 BridgeVerifier outcome with exactly reticulum.pubkey64 known: ok:both | ok:one-sided | err:unknown-key (no known key hashes to transport_key) | err:transport-sig (strict Ed25519 fails) | err:meshtastic-signed (a 0x02 record with a non-zero signature; no 2.8 XEdDSA verifier in v1) | err:node-sig:<VerifyError> (node leg first). Epochs are decimal strings; expiry is stored, never evaluated without a mesh-epoch source.
provenance: generated by tests/layer6_attest.rs::generate_layer6_vectors (ignored) through the public API: NodeLeg::issue/complete with signer a; the Reticulum Ed25519 half is RFC 8032 TEST 1, its X25519 half and the board key are RFC 7748 section 6.1 Alice/Bob public keys, the stranger is RFC 8032 TEST 2; Ed25519 is deterministic, so every record re-issues byte-exact.

cases.name: reticulum both legs
cases.rationale: 0x03: transport_key = SHA-256(X25519 || Ed25519); transport_sig = Ed25519 by the identity over tag || node_pubkey

cases.name: meshtastic one-sided
cases.rationale: 0x02: transport_key = the board's X25519 key; transport_sig = 64 zero bytes (2.7.x cannot sign) => node_sig only

cases.name: reticulum wrong hash (Ed25519 half only)
cases.rationale: the hash covers the whole 64 B key; SHA-256 of the 32 B signing half binds nothing

cases.name: reticulum wrong hash (halves swapped)
cases.rationale: the 64 B key is X25519 || Ed25519 in that order

cases.name: reticulum signature over the wrong input (no tag)
cases.rationale: transport_sig covers '111/attest-transport/v1' || node_pubkey; an untagged signature is rejected

cases.name: reticulum domain-tag confusion (node tag)
cases.rationale: a signature under '111/attest-node/v1' never stands in for the transport tag

cases.name: reticulum cross-node transplant
cases.rationale: the identity vouched for node b; node a's record carrying that signature is rejected

cases.name: reticulum all-zero signature is never one-sided
cases.rationale: the one-sided rule exists for 0x02 only

cases.name: meshtastic non-zero signature (no 2.8 verifier in v1)
cases.rationale: a 0x02 record with a signature is NOT accepted as one-sided; no XEdDSA verifier exists in v1

cases.name: meshtastic one non-zero bit
cases.rationale: only exactly 64 zero bytes marks a one-sided record

cases.name: meshtastic one-sided with node_sig flipped
cases.rationale: a one-sided record rests on node_sig alone; a bad node_sig rejects it

cases.name: reticulum record relabelled as 0x02
cases.rationale: node_sig covers transport_id; changing the registry byte breaks the node leg
